verdict.rationale: Snooze and follow-up reminders are a fair question for an email client like Zero, but nothing in the pack documents either. The MCP capability list covers labels, read/unread, archive, delete, drafts and search. The GitHub feature list and community posts never mention snoozing threads or resurfacing a thread when nobody replies.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can snooze conversations and set follow-up reminders that resurface a thread if nobody replies
